title: 第808章 孙云闭关第807章 轻松解决
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
雪云城兄弟商会分部，孙云再次闭关，正在吸收秦落衣尊者给的礼物。这份礼物，其实孙云以前得到过，是两颗极品生命原石。
现在孙云的生命空间，吸收普通的生命原石，作用已经不算太大了。这种极品生命原石，对于孙云来说绝对是宝贝，是孙云最需要的东西之一。
这种好东西，市场上显然是看不到的，只有一些有身份的人珍藏着。孙云没有想到，这秦落衣尊者能够弄到，而且还是两颗。
滋啦啦啦……
第一颗极品生命原石，孙云直接吸收到了暴风巨龙的区域，空间内产生大量的电流。孙云也是没有办法，毕竟暴风巨龙的体积在那里，属于它的空间太过于局促，必须要扩大。
吸收了极品生命原石的空间，快速地扩大了几倍，算是一片可供暴风巨龙飞翔的区域了。而且，暴风巨龙的这部分空间，自动吸收电系能量。
“吼吼吼……”
暴风巨龙直接苏醒，愉悦的到处乱跑。
暴风巨龙早就突破到了八阶，但因为一直在生命空间呆着，修炼受到了影响。有了这么大的空间，暴风巨龙就可以好好修炼了，再也不用那么憋屈了。
“这一颗融入哪里呢？”
孙云犯难了，仅剩的一颗极品生命原石，自然要谨慎使用了。在孙云身边的，只有生命之树、暴风巨龙、风速鸟和噬金鼠。
生命之树和暴风巨龙的空间，都吸收了极品生命原石，空间都有不小的变化，也可以自行吸收相应的能量了。可是，噬金鼠和风速鸟体型娇小，而且经常被放出来，暂时不增加空间也没事。
“就先吸收到仓库吧！”
孙云想了想，最终做出了决定。
巨蟒雷特的空间，一直被孙云当做仓库，堆放孙云所有的物品。随着孙云势力的增加，里面堆放的物品越来越多了，孙云经常想办法处理一些不重要的，减少占用的空间。
这里面算是孙云的老底，孙云自然要重视一下，把这块空间加固加大一下。要不然，哪天遇到了巨蟒雷特，收都没有地方收了。
“能量汇集……”
孙云既然决定了，又开始了吸收。
手中的极品生命原石，慢慢地化为能量，向孙云的大脑汇集。孙云没有留意到，随着孙云的吸收，空间里的生命之树也在慢慢吸收，枝叶更加的茂密。
……

“老大还没有出关吗？”
门外，郑健焦急的问胡老。
孙云把大致方向说给了郑健，就让郑健自由发挥了，但执行起来显然不是那么容易的。秦落衣、冷锋和艾露莎早已离去，郑健刚到这个地方，人生地不熟的，处处受到刁难。
“没有，老大说过了，没有非常重要的事情，不要打扰他！”胡老认真地回答道。
胡老现在顶替了皮猴，成为了孙云的近卫，皮猴被调去成立信息部了。皮猴跟着鬼手，也算是学了有一段时间了，这方面的能力也算可以了。
content_en:
At the Xueyun City Brothers Chamber of Commerce branch, Sun Yun was in seclusion again and was absorbing gifts from Venerable Qin Luoyi. In fact, Sun Yun had received this gift before. They were two top-quality life stones.
Now Sun Yun's life space is no longer very effective in absorbing ordinary life stones. This top-grade life stone is definitely a treasure to Sun Yun, and it is one of the things Sun Yun needs most.
This kind of good thing is obviously not available on the market, and is only treasured by some distinguished people. Sun Yun did not expect that Venerable Qin Luoyi could get two of them.
Zi la la la...
The first top-grade life stone, Sun Yun directly absorbed it into the area of the Storm Dragon, generating a large amount of electric current in the space. Sun Yun had no choice. After all, the size of the storm dragon was there, and the space belonging to it was too cramped and had to be expanded.
The space that absorbed the top-grade life stone quickly expanded several times, becoming an area where the storm dragon can fly. Moreover, this part of the storm dragon's space automatically absorbs electrical energy.
"Ho ho ho..."
The storm dragon immediately woke up and ran around happily.
The Storm Dragon had already broken through to the eighth level, but because it had been staying in the life space, its cultivation was affected. With such a large space, the Storm Dragon can practice well and no longer have to be so aggrieved.
"Where does this one fit in?"
Sun Yun was in trouble, and he had to use the only top-grade life stone he had left, so he had to use it with caution. The only people beside Sun Yun were the Tree of Life, the Storm Dragon, the Wind Speed ​​Bird and the Gold-Eating Rat.
The spaces of the Tree of Life and the Storm Dragon have both absorbed the top-quality raw life stones. The spaces have changed a lot, and they can also absorb the corresponding energy on their own. However, the Gold Rat and the Wind Bird are small in size and are often released, so it is okay not to increase the space for the time being.
"Just absorb it into the warehouse first!"
Sun Yun thought for a while and finally made a decision.
The space of Giant Python Leiter has been used by Sun Yun as a warehouse, where all of Sun Yun's belongings are piled up. As Sun Yun's power increased, more and more items were piled inside. Sun Yun often found ways to deal with unimportant items and reduce the space occupied.
This is Sun Yun's old background. Naturally, Sun Yun should pay attention to it and strengthen and enlarge this space. Otherwise, if you encounter the giant python Leiter one day, you will have no place to collect it.
"Energy gathering..."
Now that Sun Yun had decided, he started absorbing it again.
The top-grade life stone in his hand slowly turned into energy and converged into Sun Yun's brain. Sun Yun did not notice that as Sun Yun absorbed it, the tree of life in the space was also slowly absorbed, and its branches and leaves became denser.
…
"Isn't the boss out of seclusion yet?"
Outside the door, Zheng Jian asked Mr. Hu anxiously.
Sun Yun told Zheng Jian the general direction and allowed Zheng Jian to perform freely, but it was obviously not that easy to implement it. Qin Luoyi, Leng Feng and Elusa had already left. Zheng Jiang had just arrived in this place. He was unfamiliar with the place and encountered difficulties at every turn.
"No, the boss has said that there is nothing very important, so don't disturb him!" Mr. Hu replied seriously.
Mr. Hu now replaced Pihou and became Sun Yun's bodyguard. Pihou was transferred to establish the Ministry of Information. Pihou has been following Guishou for a while, and his ability in this area is pretty good.
